'''Alaswal-XT''' was an [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]]. 40mcg of the antidote, delivered at ten [[Standard hour/Legends|hourly]] intervals could treat individuals [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] by [[Mangoriza]].<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|Desperate Measures}}</ref>
